by_kind.treatment: toe: a finger lying on the crown and fused into it along its length, fed from the foot; the reading across it is the toe alone, not the metal the wax fills, which runs on into the band; a short-filled tip is built back with a laser tack. Measured thinnest section: 0.019 mm.
toe pad: a flattened disc lying on the crown, fused to it over its whole underside; the reading is across the disc's own edge, which the band behind it feeds. Measured thinnest section: 0.007 mm.
eyelid: a 0.17 mm rim round each eye, relief on the head over the 0.15 mm detail floor; the slit pupil is relief cut into the ball. Measured thinnest section: 0.002 mm.

hide relief: the face's pebbled ground (0.11 mm granules on a 0.02 mm plate over the solid face), the body's spots and the tail's rings, read where a face's ray crosses a granule's own flank or runs out through the ground plate into the face; all relief on solid metal, over the 0.15 mm detail floor. Measured thinnest section: 0.003 mm.

land_widths.method: dfm::part_sections on the sculpted part alone (one ray per face along its inward normal), and the same per face gathered by the shape nearest each face; faces sunk in the band are left out
